title: Amazon Fire TV devices are getting a free Alexa Plus upgrade
summary: More Fire TV device owners can now ask Alexa Plus for movie recommendations, jump to specific scenes, and more. Previously, Amazon made Alexa Plus available to Fire TV customers with a Prime or Alexa Plus subscription .
